name: Joaquin Bustoz Math-Science Honors Program (JBMSHP)
what_you_do: Take a 3-credit college math class over the summer. You can pick College Algebra, Pre-Calculus, or Calculus for Engineers I.
who_can_apply: Current high school juniors and seniors. You need a 3.25 unweighted GPA and A or B grades in high school math and science. You must qualify for Arizona in-state tuition and have lived in Arizona for the last 2 years.
pay_detail: Free for students in 2026: tuition, room and board, and class materials. The 2027 page lists no fee.
duration: About 6 weeks. The 2027 program is June 6 to July 16.
deadline_text: Applications for summer 2027 open in early December. Student application is due Feb 16, 2027. Recommender letter is due Feb 18, 2027.
how_to_apply: Fill out the online application. You will need financial information from a parent or guardian. Upload a one page personal or career statement. Upload an unofficial high school transcript. Have one recommender send a letter on school letterhead.
notes: The program page lists 2027 dates. Its Spanish section shows 2026 dates for the first and last program days, so confirm the dates with the program.
